India and Indonesia Sign Defence and Digital Payment Pacts

During Prime Minister Modi's visit to Indonesia, the two nations signed agreements to deepen strategic ties. Key pacts include Indonesia's acquisition of India's BrahMos and Astra missiles. The countries also agreed to integrate their digital payment systems, potentially linking India's UPI with Indonesia's QRIS. Further cooperation was established in areas such as healthcare, manufacturing, maritime security, and election technology.
